dialogue.speech: In that case, the guy who just got shot in the leg

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: is probably hiding behind the truck,

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: trying to lure me as close to him as possible so that he can attack.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Well, it's not like he's going to get me, even if I get close to him.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He's probably just beyond there.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: But so long as we don't know what his Stand is,

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: going over there alone isn't a safe plan at all.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I should wait for Giorno and—

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Well, I guess that option's out.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: The guy's in the driver's seat.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He must've jump-started the engine.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: It'll be bad news if this truck gets away right now.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Damn it! This isn't good!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I haven't seen his face yet!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Giorno probably hasn't, either!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I don't know what his Stand is yet, but I don't have a choice!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: This is for the ten billion and Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Eat lead!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Mista!
